build: Skopeo OCI copy; Umoci rootless unpack; mksquashfs -all-root -no-xattrs -noappend -comp gzip -Xcompression-level 2 -processors 4 -mem 4G
verification: OCI layout, SquashFS metadata and packaged vLLM/NIXL files checked; no GPU runtime test

local_image_adaptation.method: enroot create and export; packaged software unchanged
local_image_adaptation.note: OCI metadata describes the base image before this local SquashFS adaptation.

local_image_adaptations.method: enroot create/export; installed packages and serving settings unchanged

compiler_check: nvcc resolves through image PATH and nvcc --version succeeds in CPU-only user-namespace chroot; full GPU benchmark not re-run
